layers.process: Non-residents need a site pass for the eco-tourism sites: Morne Trois Pitons National Park sites (including Emerald Pool, Boiling Lake, Freshwater Lake, Boeri Lake and Middleham Falls), Cabrits National Park, Morne Diablotin National Park, Indian River, Trafalgar Falls and Soufrière Sulphur Springs. Site visit USD 8 (about A$11.36), one site once, private tours; day pass USD 20 (A$28.41), all eco-tourism sites except the Waitukubuli National Trail; week pass USD 50 (A$71.02), repeat visits for one week. A$ at USD 0.7040 (RBA 30 Oct 2026). Tickets are sold at visitor centres, the Division office on Windsor Park Road and vendors at or near the sites.
